name: Neural Harmonic Textures
definition: A primitive-based neural representation that increases the expressive power of individual primitives by anchoring latent feature vectors on a virtual scaffold around each primitive, applying periodic activations to interpolated features, and decoding the accumulated signal via a single deferred MLP pass.
summary: Neural Harmonic Textures is a primitive-based neural representation that encodes features with periodic functions and decodes the accumulated signal via a single deferred MLP pass per pixel.
